title: Edun
extract:
The Edun is a Duviri Polearm wielded by Dax Heralds. Performing a Heavy Attack will throw a copy of the polearm, which explodes shortly after impact.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Shimmering Blight stance.
Unique Heavy Attack throws an Edun in an arc, dealing 480 physical damage on contact, then exploding for 400  Blast damage in a 5 meter radius.

Drifter Combat
Power Strike (blocking + heavy attack, default RMB  + MMB ) quickly slashes upward in a short range to  Knockdown the foe, opening them to ground finishers.

Acquisition
The Blueprint for Edun can be purchased in Teshin's Cave for 50  Pathos Clamp or  250. Purchasing using the former will unlock the Drifter-compatible version and the blueprint for a Warframe-compatible version; purchasing using the latter will unlock both versions.
Additional Warframe blueprint copies can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for  100,000.

Combos

Notes
Normal polearm Heavy Attacks can be performed by executing Heavy Attacks during a slide.
The  Edun is not able to be thrown in the Duviri overworld. See Drifter Combat

Heavy Attack
Thrown polearms deal 480 damage, split between 30%  Impact, 40%  Puncture, and 30%  Slash, with a guaranteed  Impact proc.
1 second after collision, the polearm will explode in a 5 meter radius, dealing 400  Blast damage with a guaranteed  Impact proc. The explosion has damage fall-off.
Can be controlled by  Ivara's  Navigator.
Projectile speed can be increased by  Zephyr using  Jet Stream.
The throwing animation moves the warframe before the polearm is thrown, making the throw slightly misaligned with the aim from before the throw.
This is made worse by by Tennokai attacks, especially when combined with attack speed increases.
Throwing attacks do not benefit from the bonuses to Tennokai attacks granted by Tennokai mods, such as the increased damage from  Master's Edge, but can otherwise use the inherent benefits of Tennokai.
The initial hit and delayed explosion of thrown polearms only gain the benefits of heavy attack-exclusive effects such as  Killing Blow,  Dispatch Overdrive,  Life Strike, and the doubled crit bonus from  True Steel if the warframe is in a heavy attack animation when they hit an enemy.
This means the initial hit will often benefit at close range, but with sufficient distance from the target, and/or increases to attack speed which shorten the end-lag of the throw animation, it may not. The explosion will never gain these benefits from a single throw.
The initial hit and explosion can still gain these benefits if they hit while the warframe is performing another heavy attack after the original throw.
This includes the throwing heavy attack, normal slide heavy attacks, and even heavy attacks performed with an Exalted Weapon.
 Condition Overload only adds 20% damage per status type to the initial hit instead of the listed 80%, and does not apply its increase to the explosion damage.

Tips
Using Sacrificial Steel will raise the Critical Chance above 100%, applying the 2.6x multiplier on every normal attack.
